sources.note: The demo parameters themselves; cited for every demo_choice element.

elements.text: 40-75 years old
elements.rationale: Age at Dec 31 of the MY (the demo's shared age convention).

elements.text: Diabetes is identified by DIAGNOSIS exactly as for EED (diabetes_snomed condition active in the MY or the prior year; prediabetes never), instead of by diabetes medication fills.
elements.quote: who were dispensed at least two diabetes medication fills on unique dates of service
elements.rationale: The public D12 denominator counts Part D fills ('at least two diabetes medication fills on unique dates of service'); P6 carries no pharmacy claims and Synthea MedicationRequests are not fills, so the diagnosis is the only evidence. This widens the denominator relative to the public measure.

elements.text: Members who fall in the SPC denominator (clinical ASCVD) are NOT in the SPD denominator.
elements.rationale: Product choice: one statin gap per member, no double outreach. The public D12 measure has no such rule; SPC's stricter intensity rule takes precedence.

elements.text: Beneficiaries are only included in the measure calculation if the IPSD occurs at least 90 days before the end of the measurement period.
elements.quote: Beneficiaries are only included in the measure calculation if the IPSD occurs at least 90 days before the end of the measurement period.
elements.rationale: The index prescription start date is a Part D fill concept (no fills).

elements.text: Continuous enrollment (CE) is defined as being continuously enrolled in a Medicare Part D cont ract during the measurement period, with one allowable gap in enrollment of up to one calendar month.
elements.quote: Continuous enrollment (CE) is defined as being continuously enrolled in a Medicare Part D cont ract during the measurement period, with one allowable gap in enrollment of up to one calendar month.
elements.rationale: No enrollment records in Synthea / P6. (The corpus text carries the PDF extraction artefact 'cont ract'; quoted verbatim by design.)

elements.text: received a statin medication fill during the measurement period (numerator)
elements.quote: received a statin medication fill during the measurement period (numerator)

elements.text: ON THERAPY in the MY = a statin_rxnorm MedicationRequest authored in [Jan 1 of the MY, as_of], OR authored before the MY with status == active. Requests with status stopped, cancelled or entered-in-error never count.
elements.rationale: 'Dispensed' cannot be observed: P6 carries MedicationRequest rows, not pharmacy claims, and Synthea authors most statins once. ADR-0002 makes this rule (and E3) the only readers of MedicationRequest.status -- an explicit deviation from P6's date-only doctrine, with a leakage caveat.

elements.text: Any statin intensity counts (low, moderate or high).
elements.rationale: The public D12 numerator is any statin fill; intensity only matters for SPC.

elements.text:
The following beneficiaries are excluded from the denominator if at any time during the measurement period:
• Hospice enrollment
elements.quote:
The following beneficiaries are excluded from the denominator if at any time during the measurement period:
• Hospice enrollment
elements.rationale: Hospice enrollment is approximated by hospice_snomed events in [Jan 1 of the MY, as_of] (global rule).

elements.text: Death inside [Jan 1 of the MY, as_of] excludes the member (global rule applied to every measure).
elements.rationale: The public D12 text lists no death criterion (Part D denominators drop disenrolled beneficiaries instead). The engine applies its global death rule uniformly: a deceased member can never receive outreach.

elements.text: ESRD or dialysis in the MY or the prior year: an esrd_snomed condition active in [Jan 1 of MY-1, Dec 31 of the MY] or a dialysis_snomed procedure in that window (two exclusion categories: esrd, dialysis).
elements.quote: ESRD diagnosis or dialysis coverage dates
elements.rationale: The quoted D12 text ('ESRD diagnosis or dialysis coverage dates ... at any time during the measurement period') names the MY only; the demo mirrors SPC's MY-or-prior-year window so one statin patient is judged the same way by both rules - a WIDER window than the public text, hence demo_choice. Dialysis coverage dates are enrollment data; procedures stand in.

elements.text: Rhabdomyolysis and Myopathy
elements.rationale: No myopathy-family code appears in the committed Synthea scan (SCAN.md).

elements.text: Pregnancy, Lactation, and Fertility
elements.rationale: Lactation and fertility treatment have no codes in the committed Synthea scan; the pregnancy part IS computed (see spd/exclusion/pregnancy), so the criterion as a whole is partial.

elements.text: Pregnancy in the MY or the prior year: a pregnancy_snomed condition active in [Jan 1 of MY-1, Dec 31 of the MY] excludes the member.
elements.rationale: Mirrors SPC (shared helper evidence.pregnancy_hits) so one statin patient is judged the same way by both rules; the public D12 text names pregnancy without a window, so the window is a demo choice.

elements.text: Pregnancy is also detected from a LOINC 82810-3 'Pregnancy status' observation answered SNOMED 77386006 ('Patient currently pregnant') dated in the MY or the prior year (exclusion category pregnancy_status_positive).
elements.rationale: Synthea records pregnancy this way beside (or instead of) a pregnancy condition; the same shared helper (evidence.pregnancy_hits) serves CBP, SPC and SPD.

elements.text: Cirrhosis
elements.rationale: No cirrhosis code appears in the committed Synthea scan (SCAN.md).

elements.text: Handled at the denominator: prediabetes codes (prediabetes trap set) never qualify as diabetes, so no separate exclusion is computed.
elements.rationale: The public criterion removes fills made for prediabetes; the diagnosis-based demo denominator never admits prediabetes in the first place.

elements.text: Palliative care during the MY (HEDIS SPD criterion; not in the D12 text).
elements.rationale: No palliative-care codes appear in the committed Synthea scan (SCAN.md).

elements.text: Members 66+ enrolled in an I-SNP or living long-term in an institution (HEDIS SPD criterion; not in the D12 text).
elements.rationale: Plan enrollment data; Synthea / P6 carry no enrollment records.

elements.text: Members 66+ with frailty and advanced illness (HEDIS SPD criterion; not in the D12 text).
elements.rationale: Synthea carries no frailty claims; the global E4 flag only hints (dementia + inpatient/ED care at 66+).

elements.text: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
elements.rationale: No PCOS code appears in the committed Synthea scan (SCAN.md).

elements.text: E1 (global): a hospice event within 90 days before Jan 1 of the MY, with none inside the MY, raises a review flag. Hospice entirely BEFORE the MY is deterministically NOT an exclusion; an episode whose recorded end (performed_end_date / encounter end) falls inside [Jan 1 of the MY, as_of] IS hospice in the MY (exclusion, not E1).
elements.rationale: The public wording is 'any time during the measurement period'; 32% of living Synthea patients carry prior hospice codes, so prior hospice can only be a hint for a human, never an exclusion.

elements.text: E4 (global): a dementia diagnosis active in the MY (abatement null or after Jan 1 of the MY) OR a dementia medication authored in the MY or the prior year, plus an inpatient/ED encounter in the MY at age 66+, raises a review flag; never computed as an exclusion.
elements.rationale: The public frailty-and-advanced-illness exclusion needs two frailty indications on different dates plus advanced-illness claims; Synthea carries no frailty claims, so the engine can only hint (coverage: partial).

elements.text: E3 medication_status_conflict: a statin authored inside the MY whose MedicationRequest.status is stopped or cancelled raises a review flag, even when another statin closes the numerator.
elements.rationale: ADR-0002: this flag and the on-therapy rule are the only readers of MedicationRequest.status; a stop inside the MY may mean the therapy ended.
The 2026 Star Ratings score measurement year 2024; the demo evaluates the calendar year of as_of instead (see measurement_year).

elements.text: Measurement year (MY) = the calendar year of as_of. Denominator and exclusion windows use the MY bounds (Jan 1 - Dec 31); every numerator window ends at as_of; age = age at Dec 31 of the MY.
elements.rationale: Prospective gap detection: events dated after as_of never count, so a run at 2026-06-30 sees only what a care manager could see that day. Age at Dec 31 follows the Technical Notes wording 'as of December 31 of the measurement year'. Eval anchor as_of = 2025-12-31 (complete MY2025); demo anchor 2026-06-30.

elements.text: death_date before Jan 1 of the MY -> not_eligible (denominator no); death inside [Jan 1 of the MY, as_of] -> excluded (global rule).
elements.rationale: A member who died before the MY was never enrolled for it; the public 'died during the measurement period' wording only covers deaths inside the MY. Future death dates are masked by P6 (mask_as_of) and never seen.

normative_quote.metric: This measure is defined as the percentage of Medicare Part D benef iciaries, 40-75 years old, who were dispensed at least two diabetes medication fills on unique dates of service and received a statin medication fill during the measurement period.
normative_quote.description: This rating is based on the percent of plan members with diabetes who take the most effective cholesterol-lowering drugs.
normative_quote.conflict: D12 is a Part D pharmacy-fill measure (PQA SUPD); the demo evaluates a diagnosis-based proxy over MedicationRequest rows. The Metric text carries PDF extraction artefacts ('benef iciaries'), quoted verbatim by design.

description.heading: Description
description.text: To lower their risk of developing heart disease, most people with diabetes should take cholesterol medication. This rating is based on the percent of plan members with diabetes who take the most effective cholesterol-lowering drugs. Plans can help make sure their members get these prescriptions filled.

metric.heading: Metric
metric.text: This measure is defined as the percentage of Medicare Part D benef iciaries, 40-75 years old, who were dispensed at least two diabetes medication fills on unique dates of service and received a statin medication fill during the measurement period. The index prescription start date (IPSD) is the earliest date of service for a diabetes medication during the measurement year. Continuous enrollment (CE) is defined as being continuously enrolled in a Medicare Part D cont ract during the measurement period, with one allowable gap in enrollment of up to one calendar month. Beneficiaries are only included in the measure calculation if the IPSD occurs at least 90 days before the end of the measurement period. The percentage is calculated as the number of continuously enrolled beneficiaries, 40-75 years old, who received a statin medication fill during the measurement period (numerator) divided by the number of continuously enrolled beneficiaries, 40-75 years old, with at least two diabetes medication fills on unique dates of service during the measurement period and an IPSD t hat occurs at least 90 days prior to the end of the measurement period (denominator). The SUPD measure is adapted from t he measure concept that was developed and endorsed by the PQA. See the medication list for this measure. The SUPD measure is calculated using the NDC lists updated by the PQA. The complete NDC lists, including diagnosis codes, are posted along with these technical notes.

exclusions.heading: Exclusions
exclusions.text:
Contracts with 30 or fewer continuously enrolled beneficiaries (in the denominator). The following beneficiaries are excluded from the denominator if at any time during the measurement period:
• Hospice enrollment
• ESRD diagnosis or dialysis coverage dates
• Rhabdomyolysis and Myopathy
• Pregnancy, Lactation, and Fertility
• Cirrhosis
• Pre-Diabetes
• Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
